problem: Phone showed stale session inventory and old metadata timestamps hid recent desktop conversations.
causes: One failed 1.5-second health probe permanently selected a browser-only KV store for the page.
Cross-port browser local-network permission blocked state reads.
Remote adoption replaced objects still held by live runtimes, detaching later activity updates.
Native metadata update times were used as conversation times; historical starts were omitted with unknown running status.
changes: Web session directory always reads server state without a localStorage mirror or migration. HTTP requests use no-store.
Same-origin fixed loopback HTTP proxy for state; Vite development and preview use matching proxy rules. Direct WebSocket and file bases are unchanged.
Server adoption retains live row identity. New activity is not rolled back before its throttled save.
Independent server activity timestamps sort and label rows without claiming that historical starts prove an agent is running.
Explicit failure and automatic retry; refresh when returning to foreground or opening the session list.

red: Four old-cache unit regressions failed before the storage fix.
Old deployed frontend failed the two-device stale-cache/failed-health browser scenario.
Same-origin HTTP roundtrip returned404 before the web proxy.
Native start without a live bridge had no discoverable activity timestamp before the reader fix.
green: 4 web routing/proxy checks, including actual HTTP requests and CAS409 preservation.
npm run build:web (UI policy, typecheck, production build).

Two independent browsers against temporary real state HTTP/CAS with ACP fixture: stale local cache, failed health, desktop-to-phone additions, sorting, outage/recovery, live activity persistence after adoption, reload, no prompts. Passed on deployed frontend.
Read-only actual production inventory and native activity on390/1440px, fresh load and reload; user writes blocked and ACP restoration stubbed.
Actual Vite development and preview health requests return state JSON.
limits: Two-device creation uses ACP fixture and temporary state; no model prompts were submitted.
Actual production list reads use real server/native data, but suppress writes and real session restoration.
The browser harness observed an expected404 for absent optional history cache; missing history cache is not a session-list failure.
Automated context logged service-worker certificate errors separately; state HTTP reads succeeded on the same site origin.

deployment.asset_publish: Older hashed assets retained; index.html replaced last.
deployment.headers: /health, /api/state/sessions.json, /api/chat-session-statuses returned200 and Cache-Control:no-store through the panel origin.
